facts.about: Reliance was founded by Dhirubhai Ambani and is now promoted and managed by his elder son, Mukesh Dhirubhai Ambani. Ambani's family has about 50% shareholding in the conglomerate.

flags.text: Cash-rich profits: 5-yr operating cash = 190% of PAT
Latest quarter growth (+30%) accelerating vs 3-yr trend (+6%)

business.summary: Reliance Industries Limited is a multinational conglomerate engaged in Oil-to-Chemicals, Oil and Gas exploration, Retail, and Digital Services, making money through petroleum refining, petrochemical production, hydrocarbons extraction, consumer goods retailing, and telecommunication services.

segments.name: Oil to Chemicals (O2C)
segments.note: Refining, petrochemicals, fuels, and bulk wholesale marketing.

segments.name: Retail
segments.note: Consumer retail, digital commerce, and connectivity distribution.

segments.name: Digital Services
segments.note: Provision of digital services and telecommunication platforms.

segments.name: Oil and Gas
segments.note: Exploration, development, and production of crude oil and natural gas.

guidance.statement: We see the benefit, earnings contribution definitely starting in FY 2028.
guidance.quote: And on new energy, I just wanted to say that it is accelerating and we see the benefit, earnings contribution definitely starting in FY 2028.

guidance.statement: We will be achieving up to 20 gigawatt module capacity early next year.
guidance.quote: When it comes to the solar value chain, as indicated, I think our module capacity is now six plus gigawatt, and we will be achieving up to 20 gigawatt early next year.

guidance.statement: We are looking to double our absolute retail EBITDA number over the next three years.
guidance.quote: What we are saying is we are looking to double our absolute EBITDA number.

guidance.statement: The target is to kind of take this to Rs.1 lakh Crores on FY2030.
guidance.quote: the target is to kind of take this to Rs.1 lakh Crores on FY2030.

guidance.statement: Expects organic ARPU to improve by 5% to 6% annually.
guidance.quote: Organically, if we can improve our ARPU by 5% to 6% a year, I think that is a good number, good place to be in

scorecard.evidence: Target horizon is FY 2028; requires execution over coming years as project installations complete.

scorecard.promised: Achieve up to 20 gigawatt module capacity early next year
scorecard.evidence: Currently six plus gigawatts; run-rate needs to add ~14 GW by early next year to reach 20 GW.

scorecard.promised: Double absolute retail EBITDA over three years
scorecard.delivered: Pending; horizon 3 years from Q1 FY27
scorecard.evidence: Multi-year target in progress; tracking EBITDA trajectory following recent online investments and dark store rollouts.

scorecard.promised: Reach Rs.1 lakh Crores by FY2030
scorecard.evidence: Long-term horizon; business is currently at EBITDA breakeven while building scale and supply chain.

scorecard.promised: Improve organic ARPU by 5% to 6% annually
scorecard.delivered: ARPU reached Rs.218.8 (+3.5% YoY without tariff hikes)
scorecard.evidence: 3.5% YoY ARPU growth achieved in Q2 FY27 falls short of the target 5-6% annual organic rate.

narrative.scoreline: Management has demonstrated strong consolidated revenue and operational cash generation, though long-dated strategy commitments in new energy and retail remain unverified pending operational delivery.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: O2C performance led charge in Q2 FY27 with 68% EBITDA growth benefiting from energy market tightness.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Consolidated Q2 FY27 revenue grew 29.8% YoY to ₹3,30,601 crore with margins at 17% and net profit at ₹29,550 crore.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Retail revenue grew 6% while EBITDA was 10% lower due to quick commerce/online investments.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Consolidated revenue accelerated 29.8% YoY in Sep 2026, though consolidated operating margins dropped to 17% from peak quarter levels.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Quick commerce order run rate reached 1.6 million positioning as second largest player.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Total company cash flow from operations reached ₹1,92,113 crore in FY26, supporting ongoing operational expansion.

bull: Consolidated revenue growth accelerated strongly to 29.8% YoY in Sep 2026, reaching ₹3,30,601 crore.
Operating cash flow reached ₹1,92,113 crore in FY26, converting 190% of PAT over five years.
Free cash flow expanded significantly to ₹70,023 crore in FY26 up from ₹41,079 crore in FY25.
bear: ARPU growth of 3.5% YoY in Q2 FY27 lags behind the targeted 5% to 6% annual pace.
Cash conversion cycle lengthened to 25 days compared to 7 days three years prior.
Capital work in progress remains elevated at ₹2.33 lakh crore, tying up significant balance sheet capital.
watch: Verify if organic ARPU growth reaches the 5% to 6% annual target rate next quarter.
Track execution of solar module capacity scaling from 6 GW toward 20 GW target.
Monitor quarterly operating margin stabilization relative to quick commerce investment drag.

claims.claim: O2C led the charge with EBITDA up 68% benefiting from energy market tightness.
claims.quote: So, O2C led the charge with EBITDA up 68%. Of course, we benefited from the unprecedented tightness that we saw in energy markets

claims.claim: Jio reached 300 million 5G customers and 30 million fixed connections.
claims.quote: 300 million 5G customers, 30 million fixed, and that is half of it is FWA.

claims.claim: Retail revenue increased 6% while EBITDA was 10% lower due to online investments.
claims.quote: Retail performance has been, you would have seen the numbers, about 6% revenue increase, about 10% lower on the EBITDA side.

claims.claim: ARPU reached Rs.218.8, representing a 3.5% year-on-year growth without tariff increases.
claims.quote: Rs.218.8 as ARPU that is a 3.5% growth year-on-year in ARPU without any tariff increases.

claims.claim: Achieved record crude runs despite disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.
claims.quote: On an operational excellence point of view, record crude runs despite the disruptions in Strait of Hormuz.

claims.claim: We will continue our expansion of our dark store network in the next nine to 10 months.
claims.quote: At least next 12 months, I think in the next nine to 10 months it will continue. We are focusing on expanding the network going deeper into the markets

claims.claim: We expect to start installation after the monsoons in Kutch and start supplying power this year.
claims.quote: We expect to start installation after the monsoons in Kutch. And as the transmission network gets ready, we will start supplying power from Kutch this year.

claims.claim: We expect in the second half the prices to go up, reflecting the elevated energy prices.
claims.quote: However, we do expect, because of the elevated prices of energy and commodities all around, we expect in the second half the prices to go up

claims.claim: With new ships coming in, we will go beyond our original volume and be substantially higher.
claims.quote: and with new ships coming in, we will not only catch up that, but we will go beyond that and with all the three ships are there we will be substantially higher than that number.

claims.claim: We are breakeven on EBITDA terms, but EBITDA will improve as scale and supply chain are established.
claims.quote: yes, we are breakeven on EBITDA terms, but EBITDA will improve as a scale and all the supply chain is kind of put it across

claims.claim: Quick commerce order run rate reached 1.6 million, positioning as the second largest QC player.
claims.quote: one of the important data points is the fact that we have now 1.6 million orders run rate that is what we are doing, and very much on track to be the second largest QC player.

claims.claim: Subscriber base reached 515 million with strong customer additions of 8.9 million during the quarter.
claims.quote: customer addition strong at about 9 million, taking the total to about 515 million customers.

claims.claim: S&P upgraded the company rating from BBB Plus to A Minus due to less cyclical earnings.
claims.quote: S&P changed our rating from BBB Plus to A Minus, which is really two notches above.

claims.claim: Retail business achieved highest ever quarterly revenue at 97,600 Crores, up 8.1% year-on-year.
claims.quote: In the retail business, this quarter we had the highest ever revenue at 97,600 Crores. The revenue was up 8.1%.

risks.text: Disallowance of certain costs under the Production Sharing Contract and related arbitration matters in Oil and Gas.
Claim against the Company regarding gas migration from blocks neighbouring KG D6.
Pending appeal at the Supreme Court regarding SEBI order on trading in Reliance Petroleum Limited shares.
Impairment and recoverability risks regarding goodwill and indefinite-lived brands in Media General Entertainment CGU.
